banner.managedCentrally: Access for this organization is managed centrally in OptiNexus. Changes made here are saved there and take effect right away.

actions.revokeConfirm: Revoke the invitation of {{name}}? The link in the e-mail stops working at once.

invitations.created: Invitation created for {{email}}. OptiNexus e-mails the link; check the delivery status in the list.

delivery.failedHint: The e-mail could not be delivered. Check the address, then use Resend. If it keeps failing, contact support and quote the code shown.
delivery.queuedHint: Waiting to be sent by OptiNexus.

invitations.empty: No invitations yet. Invite the first person.

errors.alreadyAccepted: This invitation was already accepted: the person has access and signs in with OptiNexus. It cannot be changed.
errors.alreadyRevoked: This invitation was revoked, so its link no longer works. Invite the person again if they still need access.
errors.cooldown: This invitation was sent a moment ago. You can resend it in {{seconds}} s.
errors.rateLimited: Too many invitations were sent in a short time. Try again in {{seconds}} s.

hint.accepted: Accepted on {{date}}. The link was used; the person signs in with OptiNexus.
hint.expired: Expired on {{date}}. Resend it to give the person a new link.
hint.revoked: Revoked on {{date}}. The link no longer works.

invitations.howItWorks: OptiNexus e-mails the person a link. They set their own password there, which also confirms their e-mail, and then sign in. Nothing is granted until they accept. OptiFleet never sees a password or the link.
invitations.languageHint: The e-mail and the page where the person sets a password use this language.
invitations.resent: A new invitation e-mail is queued for {{email}}. The previous link no longer works.

roles.delegableCount: {{count}} permissions can be given to custom roles of this organization.
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete the role "{{name}}"? People who hold it must be changed first.
roles.droppedWarning: This role holds {{count}} permission(s) that can no longer be delegated. Saving removes them.
roles.empty: No roles yet. Create the first role.
roles.notEditable: Provided by the platform operator; it cannot be changed here.
roles.nothingDelegable: No permission can be delegated to this organization yet.
roles.onlyDelegable: Only permissions that can be delegated to this organization are listed.

state.offline: The service cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
state.outcomeUnknown: Your last change may or may not have been saved. Check the list before trying again.

users.dataScopeHint: The data scope only limits what this person sees here (for example one branch). It never adds permissions.
users.empty: No users yet. Add the first user.
users.noAssignableRoles: No roles can be assigned from here yet.
users.noPasswordHere: The person signs in with OptiNexus. OptiFleet never sees or stores a password.

outcome.created: {{name}} was added and can sign in with OptiNexus.
outcome.linked: {{name}} already had an OptiNexus account and now has access here.

users.removeConfirm: Remove the access of {{name}} to this application? Their sessions end and their roles here are removed. Their OptiNexus account stays.
users.rolesHint: Only roles that can be delegated are listed. Roles assigned by the platform operator are not changed here.
